predecessor_inputs: refs/stegverse/organization-ledger (HEAD.json, receipts/ and source-receipts/, read only; the source through resident-runtime/organization_batch_custody.py::verified_organization_source_receipt)
downstream: scripts/project_worker_claim_into_canonical_task.py projects the derived worker row into the canonical task record; it requires the canonical task to be admitted (coordination_state not PROPOSED) and remains its own transition.

domains.ORGANIZATION_CLAIM_ALLOCATOR: fence = max(chain grants, provenance floor 7) + 1, issued by scripts/consume_org_claim_allocator_request.py and recorded on refs/stegverse/organization-ledger
domains.WORKERCOORDINATOR_GENERATION: control/worker-registry.json generation; heartbeat_runtime/worker_runtime_legacy.py sets fencing_token = generation = previous + 1

rules.rule: the derived claim lands in control/worker-registry.json, the only execution_claim_and_fence surface
the allocator fence is carried verbatim with fence_domain ORGANIZATION_CLAIM_ALLOCATOR and the grant transition id as claim_id; no WorkerCoordinator-domain fence is minted
decided_by: TASK_REGISTRY_CANONICAL_INVARIANTS.md Worker-claim field invariant (a session or model identity is never claim or fence authority)

rules.rule: successor generation = max(generation + 1, fence + 1): never lowered, and no later WorkerCoordinator mint can reuse an integer at or below a projected allocator fence
an allocator fence already projected from another receipt, a superseded grant, or a task already holding a claim is FAIL_CLOSED; the same receipt replays with no change
ordering is the registry generation and the receipt hb_reference.epoch; a receipt with derived_from_clock true is refused and updated_at is left as found
decided_by: org-kernel/kernel.py hb_reference (progression OSCILLATOR_ONLY; epoch from the carrier)

rules.rule: the receipt travels inline and is re-verified by digest and by Organization chain membership; its retained source receipt is read back through the existing Organization verifier, bound to source_transition_sha256, and must be the allocator repository's own GRANTED receipt for the same task, fence and disposition with a carrier epoch; without a ledger read the transition fails closed

fence_domain_reconciliation.undecided: Whether the two domains should become one counter is not decided by these invariants; JDQ-3 in the coordination INDEX joint discovery queue. Default until decided: namespaced, as above.

dispositions.ALLOW: derived bytes and evidence; no ledger append

execution_locus: AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL: the workflow only verifies; apply runs where the worker registry's own write path is authorized
